environment: Linux CPU, Python 3.12.13, Torch 2.8.0+cpu, faster-whisper 1.2.1, CTranslate2 4.8.2, Silero 6.0.0, FFmpeg 6.1.1, four Torch/OMP threads

model.network: local weights only; ORT import blocked

input.source: Existing public JFK sample repeated three times with silence; provenance in docs/subtitles.md

method.execution: Separate real Jobs workers: legacy complete-audio control; complete span control; kill worker 0.8 s after second span invocation, recover Store and resume same job
method.translation: Fixed Korean fixture; no actual MT or browser evidence in this probe

failures_and_fixes: Initial restored model folder lacked preprocessor_config.json: expected 128 input features, got 80. Restored pinned file; app now rejects missing config before inference.
Fresh reviewer found special prompt tokens and possible predicted timestamp overshoot; plain encoding and fresh-output clipping fixed before successful runs.
limits: One repeated English sample, no natural long-dialogue or multilingual quality conclusion.
Full decode and VAD repeat; no replay-duration cap for uninterrupted speech.
Single-run timings include process/model loading and fixture translation; not throughput forecasts.
No Windows 11/RTX or new browser validation.
